description: What Sandooq publishes about one MENA market: VAT rate, e-invoicing posture, currency, how tenders are handled, the regulator, and the market notes shown on that country's page.

country.description: Country to describe, as a lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. One of: sa, qa, ae, bh, om, sy, lb.

locale.description: Response language: 'en' (default) or 'ar'. Arabic returns the Arabic copy the site publishes, not a translation of the English.
